channel.title: RWA Wire
channel.description: News, research and explainers on real-world assets, tokenization and the infrastructure transforming global finance.

item.title: IMF research examines the settlement asset behind tokenized finance
item.description: IMF research examines how tokenization changes financial infrastructure. The asset used for settlement remains a separate question from the technology recording a transaction.

item.title: Kyobo Securities explores tokenized assets alongside venture investments
item.description: Seoul Economic Daily reports research into asset-backed offerings and distribution infrastructure, alongside existing technology investments; live product terms are not established.

item.title: Ether and Solana ETFs record weekly outflows in October report
item.description: The Block reports $542.1 million leaving ether funds and $24.8 million leaving Solana funds; these ETF flows do not measure tokenized-securities redemptions.

item.title: Jesse Pollak expects equities and local-currency stablecoins to drive Base growth
item.description: In an October 9 interview, the Base creator outlined a forecast and reported trading activity; those claims should be separated from independently verified market data.

item.title: Cuomo presents tokenized stocks as a market opportunity for OKX–ICE
item.description: An October 9 Wall Street Journal interview presents Cuomo's outlook on tokenized equities. His role at OKX–ICE makes the remarks a venture participant's perspective.

item.title: Binance announces four more bStocks as collateral assets
item.description: Binance announced four additional bStocks on October 7. The expansion creates another collateral use case, but the announcement alone does not measure adoption or liquidity.

item.title: AFM and DNB identify a legal gap for native securities tokenization
item.description: The Dutch authorities say token-only issuance lacks a current legal basis, leaving firms with parallel records and calling for a joint policy follow-up.

item.title: IMF working paper puts governance and legal certainty at the center of tokenization
item.description: An IMF working paper examines the institutions behind tokenized finance. Its analysis offers a framework for governance questions, rather than proof of a new global rulebook.

item.title: Richard Teng links tokenization demand to private-market information gaps
item.description: A Binance News report attributes strong tokenization demand to Richard Teng while highlighting information gaps in private markets. That assessment is a participant's view, not an adoption measure.

item.title: Securitize launches share-backed stock tokens with security entitlements
item.description: The October 8 offering begins on Solana through Securitize's broker-dealer; planned NYSE and OKXICE access remains conditional.

item.title: Seoul Exchange Prepares for Unlisted-Share Token Trading Under Korea's 2027 Framework
item.description: Seoul Exchange says it is pursuing an OTC brokerage license and preparing tokenized unlisted-share trading for Korea's first-stage framework in February 2027.

item.title: Research examines liquidity incentives for fragmented stock-token markets
item.description: The Block's October 8 report studies competing wrappers and venues; its exchange-incentive thesis is research rather than proof of an implemented market solution.

item.title: Community-bank survey shows limited current use of tokenized deposits
item.description: The 2026 CSBS survey separates planned adoption from current services: most respondents have neither offering nor plans to add them within a year.

item.title: DNB and Commercial Bank of Dubai expand the CBMT deposit sandbox
item.description: The eight-bank test network now includes a Gulf participant and four currencies; joining the sandbox does not constitute a commercial launch.

item.title: Tether and Kazakhstan authorities study a tenge stablecoin and tokenization pilot
item.description: An October 7 memorandum outlines research and pilot proposals with the National Bank and Alatau City Authority; it does not announce a circulating stablecoin.

item.title: Chainlink executive's Korea outlook meets a still-developing 2027 framework
item.description: Nick Ariasinghe's acceleration forecast sits alongside the FSC's proposed rules and consultation timetable; it should not be presented as guaranteed market growth.

item.title: Stock-token transfers rose in Binance Research's quarterly comparison
item.description: The report compares onchain transfers in Q1 and Q3; a transfer total counts repeated movements and is not the value of newly issued securities.

item.title: Securitize and LG CNS explore tokenized assets for Korean institutions
item.description: Their October 6 memorandum covers product research and financial infrastructure, with any resulting services subject to approvals rather than already launched.

item.title: CFTC chair calls for markets to prepare for tokenization
item.description: Michael Selig's September 22 speech emphasizes collateral mobility and market modernization, but a policy speech does not authorize every tokenized product.

item.title: OKX–ICE venture seeks SEC approval for tokenized stock trading
item.description: Reuters reported an October 5 filing by the OKX–ICE venture for a tokenized trading platform. A regulatory filing is a proposal, rather than evidence of a live service.

item.title: Perpetual Futures Explained: Funding, Leverage and Liquidation
item.description: Learn how crypto perpetual futures work, including funding rates, leverage, margin, liquidation, mark price and the risks traders should understand before using perps.

item.title: What Are Real-World Assets (RWA) in Crypto?
item.description: A practical guide to real-world assets in crypto: what RWAs are, how tokenization works, where yield comes from, the main risks, and why institutions care.

item.title: BlackRock and Ondo portfolio strategies extend tokenization beyond single assets
item.description: CoinDesk reports portfolio-level tokens representing model strategies, a different structure from simply holding several individually tokenized investments.

item.title: Copy Trading Explained: How It Works, Risks and What to Check
item.description: A practical guide to crypto copy trading: how follower orders are created, why results can differ from the lead trader, which metrics matter and what risks to understand before copying a strategy.

item.title: Crypto Futures Explained: Perpetuals, Margin, Funding and Liquidation
item.description: A practical guide to crypto futures and perpetual contracts: how margin, leverage, funding rates, liquidation and trading fees work, and what traders should check before using derivatives.

item.title: Crypto Leverage Explained: How Margin Amplifies Gains and Losses
item.description: Understand leverage in crypto trading, including notional exposure, margin, liquidation, position sizing and why higher leverage sharply reduces room for error.

item.title: RWA Crypto Explained: What Real-World Assets Mean Onchain
item.description: A practical guide to real-world assets in crypto: what gets tokenized, how the structure works, where the risks sit and why institutions care.

item.title: Chainlink demonstrates a cross-chain dividend workflow in Swift's hackathon
item.description: The demonstration coordinated a cash dividend across four blockchains, from announcement to reconciliation; it is a hackathon result rather than a market-wide production service.

item.title: Prometheum argues for clearer investor rights in tokenized equities
item.description: Prometheum's critique of synthetic stock tokens is a commercial participant's opinion. Investor.gov provides a separate framework for distinguishing issuer, custodial and synthetic tokenized securities.

item.title: Wells Fargo CFO puts interoperability at the center of tokenized deposits
item.description: At Sibos, Mike Santomassimo argued that isolated bank networks cannot deliver the interoperability needed for cross-border tokenized-deposit settlement.

item.title: Binance expands bStocks collateral support with seven securities
item.description: Binance's September 30 announcement extends collateral eligibility to seven bStocks. Eligibility on a trading platform does not establish shareholder rights or a universal collateral value.

item.title: Securitize plans ADI Chain integration for eligible tokenized products
item.description: The integration creates another potential network route for regulated assets, while product eligibility and jurisdictional requirements continue to apply.

item.title: Binance Research reports stock-token value above $3 billion in September
item.description: The report's late-September snapshot measures outstanding token value, not exchange turnover or evidence that tokenized markets have replaced traditional equities.

item.title: Avalanche's reported stock-token inflows require a dated comparison
item.description: A September 29 report puts Avalanche ahead in one weekly inflow measure; that ranking should not be confused with holder growth or permanent market leadership.

item.title: Kakaopay Securities studies overseas distribution of Korean stock tokens
item.description: Separate partnerships with Ondo and Dinari cover distribution research and a proof of concept, not an already available international stock-token service.

item.title: Injective RWA perpetuals provide price exposure, not direct asset ownership
item.description: Injective offers perpetual markets linked to equities, commodities and other references. Understanding the derivative is essential before treating that exposure as ownership of an underlying asset.

item.title: Backed Explained
item.description: A profile of Backed, an issuer of tokenized securities whose product infrastructure includes tokenized equities distributed as xStocks.

item.title: Figure Explained
item.description: A profile of Figure, a blockchain-native capital marketplace spanning loan origination, tokenized credit, onchain lending and digital asset infrastructure.

item.title: Franklin Templeton Brings Tokenized Money-Market Collateral to Bybit
item.description: Eligible institutional clients can pledge Benji-issued tokenized money-market fund shares for USDT or USDC trading credit while the assets remain in off-exchange custody.

item.title: Goldfinch Explained
item.description: A profile of Goldfinch and Goldfinch Prime, focused on bringing private-credit investment strategies onto blockchain rails.

item.title: Maple Finance Explained
item.description: A profile of Maple, an onchain asset manager focused on institutional lending, credit strategies and yield-bearing digital assets.

item.title: Oracle, IBM and Cosmos outline connections to Swift's tokenized-deposit ledger
item.description: The vendors describe different integration routes, including IBM's beta messaging adapter; connectivity announcements should not be counted as universal production access.

item.title: Plume Network Explained
item.description: A profile of Plume, a blockchain ecosystem purpose-built for bringing real-world assets onchain and integrating them with DeFi.

item.title: Polymesh Explained
item.description: A profile of Polymesh, a public permissioned blockchain designed specifically for regulated assets and capital-market workflows.

item.title: Securitize Explained
item.description: A profile of Securitize, a regulated tokenization platform providing issuance, transfer-agent and market infrastructure for tokenized securities and funds.

item.title: September tokenization policy: Korea's roadmap and a U.S. venue exemption
item.description: Two September policy documents address different parts of tokenized markets: South Korea's implementation roadmap and a conditional U.S. exemption for certain securities venues.

item.title: Superstate Explained
item.description: A profile of Superstate, a tokenization platform connecting regulated investment funds and public equities with onchain capital markets.

item.title: How Does Asset Tokenization Work?
item.description: A step-by-step guide to asset tokenization, from legal structuring and custody to token issuance, compliance, trading, settlement and redemption.

item.title: RWA Infrastructure Explained: The Stack Behind Tokenized Finance
item.description: A guide to the infrastructure behind real-world assets and tokenized finance, from legal structuring and custody to blockchains, data, interoperability, trading and settlement.

item.title: Stablecoins Explained: How Digital Dollars Work
item.description: A practical guide to stablecoins: how fiat-backed digital dollars work, what backs them, how redemption and reserves matter, and why they are becoming settlement infrastructure.
